## What is this?
- [ ] A new/updated **style pack** under `styles/<slug>/`
- [ ] Docs / judgment-layer change

## Style pack checklist (delete if not a style pack)
- [ ] `STYLE.md` has all required fields; `slug` matches folder
- [ ] at least one 16:9 sample in `samples/`
- [ ] a reproducible prompt formula (SURFACE × SKELETON × DEVICE)
- [ ] `license: CC-BY-4.0`; artwork mine / attributed; no client content or copyrighted text
- [ ] ran `python3 build_gallery.py`
- [ ] commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
